long_biography.plain_text:
Wellness became Nerio Alessandri's organising idea for a business that combined exercise equipment, industrial design and digital services. Technogym moved beyond individual machines toward a connected training ecosystem, serving fitness centres, elite sport and home users. The approach placed regular movement within a broader vision of physical and mental wellbeing rather than treating exercise only as appearance or performance.

Alessandri extended that vision beyond the company through the Wellness Foundation, established to promote active lifestyles as a social opportunity. Its Wellness Valley project brings public institutions, businesses and community organisations together across Romagna around health, education and quality of life. He continues to chair the foundation while directing the company's long-term development.
